name: directions-by-mode
title: Getting here
description: How to arrive by train, bus, car, bike and on foot, with routes that start at the station, a facts line for each and a step-free access panel.
docs: Pass the address, a mapHref and the modes in the order people use them. Each mode has a kind (train, bus, car, bike, walk, ferry or plane) that picks its icon, a title that names it in words, and a body: one paragraph, or an array for numbered steps. Write every route from the place people start, with stop names, line numbers and the last 200 metres, and wrap those in strong. facts are label and value pairs such as the journey time from a named origin and the parking cost; link adds a timetable or parking-map link, routed with linkAs. access is the separate panel for step-free entry, lifts, accessible parking and assistance dogs: its points are sentences, or a short label with its sentence. From 1024px it stays in view beside the routes while they scroll past; set --sticky-top on the section to the height of a sticky header you have (2rem by default). The icons that have a motion play it when a row is hovered or focused and stay still for reduced motion. Pass labels to translate the fixed words.
